messages:
ashley: Setting up a BYOK custody tabletop tomorrow 08:30 PT. Focus: RBAC JIT flows, audit fidelity, KMS rewrap fallback. Staging only, no prod HSM.

kevin: ACK. Will we simulate a customer import or a staged operator import with synthetic keys?

ashley: Staged operator import using synthetic keys on staging HSM. Objective: test mid-operation entitlement revocation and automatic rewrap. Runbook draft: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/byok-tabletop (update forthcoming).

maria: Audit requirements: include actor_email, actor_role, admin_session_id, mfa_present in every KMS/HSM event. We need to be able to produce signed digests for SOC2 within 48h after the drill.

ashley: Staging logs have 90d retention. We'll add those fields and produce a SHA256 digest of the exported logs to sign.

tony: I'll create a JIT role. What's least-priv for the drill?

ashley: Role name: tableop_byo_operator. Allowed: kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:ReEncrypt, kms:DescribeKey. Deny: production key ARNs and kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion. Conditions: sourceVPC==staging-vpc AND mfa==true. TTL 60m.

kevin: For detection we should instrument a query to find rapid rewraps or unknown principals. Example GCP extract:

PROJECT=redwood-staging
gcloud logging read 'resource.type=kms_key' --freshness=72h --project="$PROJECT" --format=json > /tmp/byok-logs.json
jq -r '.[] | {ts: .timestamp, action: .jsonPayload.action, actor: .jsonPayload.actor_email, session: .jsonPayload.admin_session_id}' /tmp/byok-logs.json

maria: On vuln triage: vendor HSM advisory CVE-2026-4242 affects an old staging image. Low remote exploitability; we will not patch during drill. Simulate operator compromise instead.

ashley: Drill plan: start normal flow, mid-run revoke the JIT role, trigger fallback rewrap service account, and measure detection-to-rewrap time.

sec-bot: :warning: Runbook missing: "notify-legal" and "archive-audit-digest" steps. Please add before execution.

oncall-night: I'll own the handoff. Suggest sealing emergency unseal token in Vault with dual-approval and logging unseal ops. I will shadow operator.

tony: Will deploy IAM role and inline prod-deny policy to staging.

kevin: Post-drill extraction snippet for auditors included above. Also set alert to page SRE if rewrap errors exceed threshold.

maria: After-action deliverables: timeline, RBAC delta, log digest, compliance memo for legal, remediation plan if rewrap fails.

ashley: Thanks team. I'll update the runbook and post final checklist + calendar invite. :white_check_mark:
